title: A Wonder
text: I can not say anything negative, it has made us enjoy seeing main monuments of the city, with another perspective because it has made us learn a lot. Very punctual and friendly, recommended 100%!!
author: SOL032

title: Wonderful tour!
text: Laura is a fabulous guide. Attentive and fun, and knowledgeable. She also gave us some great recommendations. I wouldn’t hesitate to try out with Laura!
author: winterberry2020

title: Seville cathedral and much more!
text: Laura was beyond amazing. She took us to multiple spots and even stopped for lunch with us and helped us over delicious sandwiches! She was so knowledgeable on all of the history we couldn’t believe it. She was so kind and caring and guided us through the city In such a calmly enjoyable manor. I would recommend Laura to anyone!! She truly made our experience wonderful.
author: R8543TZbriannad

title: EXCELLENT visit
text:
The visits with Laura were super great, her way of explaining everything made us move and travel through the history of Seville.
Your advice on where to eat is also very accurate (which is something very important hehehe)
Without a doubt the best choice.
author: MsMv_13

title: Laura is incredible!
text:
I absolutely loved this tour so much! Laura was absolutely incredible. She was so knowledgeable and had so many interesting facts about the history of Seville. I was amazed! 

The cathedral and the palace were absolutely and unbelievable beautiful. It was incomprehensibly stunning and I could have spent a whole week there. 

I one hundred perfect recommend Laura and this tour!!!
author: kak834

title: Excelente
text:
Somos de esos clientes qué tras muchas visitas por libre a Sevilla, optamos por la escucha para completar lo conocido, y les garantizo que no pudo ser mejor. Laura cuenta con abanico amplio de recursos para convertir una visita en un viaje. Ameno, sólido, y al compás. Sevilla habla sola, pero nada como que te ayuden a escucharla. Gracias por la orientación, la solvencia y la pasión. Les aseguro que no hay nada más recomendable que dejarte acompañar por quién ama lo que hace, y lo hace como si fuera el primer día.
